purpose: Stage and independently review only inert Local Mistral review-input, prompt-bundle, inference-payload and candidate-validation contract logic.
baseDependencies: PR #5324/#5326/#5327/#5328 remain stacked prerequisites before final activation.
requiredInvariants: This PR remains inert: it performs no filesystem artifact authority, process launch, network request, model invocation, attestation/status publication or product/API/database/RBAC/registration/cabinet behavior.
Diff, policy, schema and changed-path inputs must be regular non-symlink files with fixed byte bounds and strict UTF-8/JSON parsing where applicable.
Changed paths must be a non-empty unique bounded list and become the exact finding-path authority for candidate validation.
Review diff is fail-closed screened for credential-like material, e-mail addresses and phone-like PII before prompt construction.
Untrusted diff bytes escape model control delimiters and are embedded only inside canonical review-input JSON under a fixed user instruction that preserves the trusted system policy boundary.
Prompt-bundle SHA-256 binds trusted system policy, user prompt and response schema; manifest SHA-256 binds full diff SHA/size and sorted changed paths.
Inference payload fixes model identity, deterministic temperature/top-p/seed/max-token settings, non-streaming mode and strict JSON-schema response format.
Response extraction requires the exact model identity, exactly one choice, accepted stop reason, bounded non-empty content and no <think> leakage.
Candidate validation accepts only findings=[] or exactly one strict P0/P1/P2 finding with an authorized changed path, positive line, bounded title/reason and no speculative-reason wording.
Canonical candidate output is deterministic JSON and bounded before publication.
Sensitive-output screening remains an additional separately admitted layer and is not weakened by this contract.
Local Qwen remains the independent reviewer for this future Local Mistral authority change.
REG.RU remains production authority, mandatory SaaS/API keys remain none and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
